title: nhd-sink-display
description: Device config entry for a device of type "nhd-sink-display" (also "nhdsinkdisplay") - a display controlled through the NetworkHD decoder it is plugged into, backed by NhdSinkDisplayProperties (NhdSinkDisplayProperties.cs). The path is one-way, so the reported power state is the last command sent.

key.description: Unique identifier for this device within the configuration file.

name.description: Friendly display name for this device.

type.description: Discriminator identifying the plugin factory that instantiates this device. Accepted aliases are equivalent.

decoderKey.description: Key of the NetworkHD decoder device the display is connected to.

powerOnCommand.description: RS-232 string that turns the display on, sent through the decoder with the serial settings in the decoder's rs232 block. When this and powerOffCommand are both empty, the decoder's sink-power proxy is used instead.

powerOffCommand.description: RS-232 string that turns the display off. See powerOnCommand.

warmingTimeMs.description: How long the display is reported as warming up after power on.

coolingTimeMs.description: How long the display is reported as cooling down after power off.
